name: cover
description: Fills at least the viewport's height and centers one child vertically, with optional content pinned above and below it.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: Minimum space between the centered child and whatever sits above or below it.

children.description: A header, the centered child, a footer: any of them optional except the centered one.
Exactly one child carries data-center and is centered in the remaining space.

tokens.name: --yeti-cover-height
tokens.description: The minimum block size. Set it to auto for a cover no taller than its content.

a11y.notes: Purely visual. Keep the page's h1 inside the cover when the cover is the hero.
